name: fork-parity
summary: Model the client on Fork: staging, commit box, detail tabs
body:
Modeled directly on Fork running side-by-side (closed source — its
interaction patterns, our implementation): icon toolbar with a repo/
branch card and Stash; sidebar with pinned views, a filter field and
collapsible Branches/Remotes/Tags/Stashes/Submodules (refs now carry
tip shas for decorations); Local Changes with Unstaged/Staged areas,
stage/unstage (git add / restore --staged), per-area diffs (--cached
for staged) and a subject/description/amend commit box that commits
the staged set; All Commits with a graph rail, branch/tag badges and
a Commit / Changes / File Tree detail panel (collapsed-chain file
tree, unit-tested). Views land where the work is and refreshes never
yank the selection or view.
